tiktok.insight: TikTok spent $28.1k in the week of 2026-10-12 (14% of paid spend). On ad groups that were spending, it credits itself ROAS 0.53 on iOS and 0.49 on Android; TikTok's own number, not comparable with Meta's. App Store money follows Meta iOS spend, barely TikTok's: hold the budget until the geo test.
tiktok.action: Run the geo test (pause TikTok iOS in 3–4 countries for 4 weeks). Send the TikTok ad-level export with v5 names so its creatives get verdicts too.
